fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: A mote of fire hurled at a creature or object within range.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature; it ignores half cover.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains hit points. (The casting-ability bonus is added by the engine at cast time.)

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Three glowing darts of magical force strike unerringly; each dart deals 1d4+1 force damage.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A creature you can see regains hit points. Cast as a bonus action; treated as an action until the bonus-action economy lands.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.description: Protective magical force surrounds the target: base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier until it dons armor or the spell is dismissed.
mage_armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Creatures fall unconscious. Simplified: a single WIS save or be incapacitated; the two-stage unconscious ladder and waking on damage are not modeled.
sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand)
